scope: Seven selected action/encounter descriptor name literals only. Complete enclosing table roles and state identity maps support their value correspondence; callback code is not admitted merely because names match.

sources.policy: Static data and ordinary Steam .shared code only; no protected .arch decode, game/emulator execution, byte-similarity proof or no-reference absence inference.

action.ps2_list_update: 001b0a60; same:122-183, pendingstate*12 init and currentstate*12+4 update
action.nso_list_update: 1b9f0..1bb30, worker0, actual action list/pending/float clock and callback+8

negative_evidence.requirement: Action table is38 PS2 records, not35: DEAD/EXIT/TEST continue after END HOME. Golden has42, not39. Whole typed callback/name parsing plus actual indexed reader fixes both boundaries.
Encounter table begins5f7180, not5f7190; labels are fields+8 of12-byte records. Golden uses24-byte records, not an inferred56-byte structure based on one name gap.
Name ESCAPE_MES has both camera and action references. Actual action pointer field selects709d50/Steam a24f20, not camera70aa28/afa3b8.

required_seams.owner: Golden action/encounter name field supplier
required_seams.requirement: Route selected Golden label values by typed descriptor identities, never an unqualified string match or a camera-table ESCAPE_MES reference. Author exact qualified NUL-terminated names and preserve only listed PS2 alignment tails. Cover actual direct/translated/inlined/native references and PS2 mode isolation. Host function/name pointers must never be copied into guest pointer tables.

required_seams.owner: action live state producers and list lifecycle
required_seams.requirement: Actual Golden allocationa490 creates0x528-byte action, clears it, initializes target/real UID and monotonic wrapping action ID, actual RNG(60) delay and previous/next links at518/520, publishes battle.actions+1c0, currentu16 state+c=0 and invokes init0. a590 publishes actual requestedu16 state, oldstate+10 and resets float elapsed+24 before init callback through42*24 table. Actual listupdate1b9f0 reads pendingstate+e and float delay+14, advances using real engine delta277bb0*0.5, commits delayed transition then init; enabled state invokes callback+8, increments actual float elapsed, otherwise unlinks/releases marked nodes while preserving next. Bind actual action/unit references, current/pending/old states, flags1c/20 and frame clock, not fabricated static state samples. This is reader/name correspondence, not proof of callback gameplay equivalence.

required_seams.owner: encounter phase live state and transitions
required_seams.requirement: Actual Golden setphase5fb90 publishes realu32 phase at battle+458, clears elapsed460/464, invokes init. Update5fbf0 commits pending+45c, invokes init, clears pending, dispatches current update+8, stores actual nonzero returned nextphase as pending, snapshots elapsed and adds real delta277bb0*0.5. Reset5fc90 enters1, invokes init, clears pending after callback. Preserve actual phase-work pointer, scene/unit/round producers, callbacks and task lifetime; no zeroed synthetic battle phase.
